summary: Frontend-only refinement validation for Relais IT homepage. Verified header (6 nav links + Demander un devis CTA + mobile hamburger open/close), bigger logo (h-12 sm:h-14), hero title + 2 CTAs, exact card counts (Services=6 no 'En savoir plus', Solutions=4, Why=6, Formations=3), Contact section with NO form/inputs/submit, 3 contact cards (téléphone/email/localisation), 3 action buttons with correct hrefs (tel:+2250747732557, mailto:contact@relaisit.com, https://wa.me/2250747732557), simplified Footer with logo/brand/phone/email/location/copyright. Mobile (390px) tested separately. 35/35 assertions PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact card testids use lowercased label including French diacritic ('contact-téléphone'). This works (the spec uses the same id) but unicode testids can be brittle; consider 'contact-phone' for portability.
Footer 'Trust it.' tagline appears twice (brand line + bottom-right) — minor redundancy but acceptable.
Hero right-side decorative SVG is hidden on <lg screens (good), but the floating stat cards rely on the SVG being visible; on lg+ they render correctly. No bug.
Backend /api/contact endpoint still exists though public site no longer posts to it — admin still consumes it. Per E1 note, intentional.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refined Relais IT public homepage validated via Playwright at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Key testids verified: site-header, logo-link, header-cta-devis, nav-{accueil,services,solutions,formations,apropos,contact}, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-menu, mobile-nav-services, hero-section, hero-cta-services, hero-cta-devis, service-card-0..5 (service-more absent), solution-card-0..3, why-card-0..5, formation-card-0..2, contact-section (zero inputs/forms/submit), contact-téléphone/email/localisation, contact-call-btn, contact-email-btn, contact-whatsapp-btn, site-footer. Mobile menu opens via toggle and auto-closes on nav click. Header CTA and nav-contact both smooth-scroll to #contact.
rca of the issue: N/A — refinement matches spec; no defects found.
